messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration for maximizing the minimum triangle area among all 286 triangles formed by 13 points in the unit square places the 13 points at vertices of the integer lattice points {(i/3, j/3) : 0 <= i, j <= 3} with one point removed, specifically the point (1/3, 1/3). This configuration achieves a minimum triangle area of 1/18, and no arrangement of 13 points in the unit square can achieve a strictly larger minimum area. The key obstruction is that any denser packing forces three points sufficiently close to collinear, bounding the smallest triangle area at or below 1/18."}
